notes.title: On the edge of new begginings, major changes and the end for the early access!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings once again, mighty heroes![/b]

We come one more time to keep you informed about some significant major changes on MinosMaze. Our focus on a better gameplay experience resulted on the following actualizations for this patch:
[list]
[*]Reworked third person camera, you can now choose if it is fixed, or not, on the view.

[*]Better camera positioning while on a fight.

[*]Vision/Control sensibility improved.

[*]Focal point option enabled, reducing motion sickness.

[*]Scrollbar quantitative on options.

[*]Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]
Game's versions on early access are coming to an end, therefore we will stabilize and fix eventual bugs. It has been a great experience for our team interacting with the community, wich helped a lot to develop MinosMaze. We believe it is time to move forward and full release the official version with a base price actualization.

We hope you all continue to contribute to our game helping us to fix all bugs and problems that may appear from now on.

Thank you all for keeping up so far, we wish you stay with us for the future challenges!

notes.title: New translations, minor changes and new "MinosMaze: No Exit Pack" bundle!
notes.notes:
[i]Привет авантюристов!
Saluti avventurieri!
Salutations aventuriers![/i]
Greetings adventurers!

Once again we came with some new exciting features on MinosMaze. It is each day closer to be completed and we are proud to put such amount of effort in this.

We did some minor in game changes and translated it to other three languages hoping you feel more comfortable playing our game.

It is now available at Steam Store our new bundle "MinosMaze: No Exit Pack" with both MinosMaze game and exclusive soundtrack: http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1697

[b]In game changes:[/b]
[list][*]Theseus has some new animations.

[*]Animated blood physics more accurate.

[*]Arachne model reworked.[/list]

[b]New translations:[/b]
[list][*]French

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/196148657e785c32a86418a28ef3c4d79dc1de94.png[/img]

[*]Italian

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/bd2ef8fc52cbb916dd6e3460d8e678e14d81fb0a.png[/img]

[*]Russian

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26174993/c2ea187f0805fb522bfc51288edff51a0a069843.png[/img][/list]

Our team wish you all have fun with MinosMaze and count on your collaboration to make it the best it can be. If there are any translation problems or in game bugs please let us know at the community section.

Team MinosMaze
